incoming.name: Gas tungsten arc welding
incoming.excerpt: Cerium oxide (or ceria) as an alloying element improves arc stability and ease of starting while decreasing burn-off.

outgoing.name: Germany
outgoing.excerpt: Cerium was discovered in Sweden by Jöns Jakob Berzelius and Wilhelm von Hisinger, and independently in Germany by Martin Heinrich Klaproth, both in 1803.
